result:
This all looks correct. The implementation is complete:

- **`src/server/services/member-service.ts`**: added `suspendMember`, `reinstateMember`, `MemberSuspendedError`; last-owner check now only counts non-suspended owners.
- **`src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts`**: added `setMemberStatus` (status-only update, doesn't touch `archivedAt`); `countActiveMembers` now counts all live members (suspended included), only removal frees a seat.
- **`src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts`**: seat rollup counts suspended members too.
- **`src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts`**: org switcher (`listOrgsForUser`) excludes suspended members.
- **`src/types/event.ts`** / **`src/types/activity.ts`** / **`src/schemas/activity.ts`**: added `member.suspended`/`member.reinstated` events and audit actions.
- **`src/server/services/activity-service.ts`**: audit-log listeners for the two new events.
- **`src/schemas/member.ts`**: `suspendMemberSchema`/`reinstateMemberSchema`.
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`**: `notify()` skips recipients who aren't active members.
- **`src/server/services/digest-service.ts`**: `buildDigest` returns `null` for non-active recipients, leaving their notifications unread until reinstated.
- **`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`**: `createIssue`/`assignIssue` throw `MemberSuspendedError` when the assignee is suspended.
- **`src/server/services/comment-service.ts`**: mention resolution only considers active members.
- **`src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`**: labels for the new audit actions (required by typecheck).

Full test suite (617 tests) and typecheck/lint all pass with no changes needed to existing tests.
